tool_a.purpose: Ranks repository files by relevance to a natural-language question, weighting rare terms over common ones.
tool_a.inputs: question (string, required); top (integer, optional, default 5 — maximum results).
tool_a.outputs: JSON array of repo-relative file paths, most relevant first. Paths only; no scores.
tool_a.failure_behaviour: Status OK with an empty array when no file scores above zero.

tool_b.purpose: Searches multiple search sources at once — full-text documents, a code graph, a mechanism registry — into one ranked list.
tool_b.inputs: query (string, required); top (integer, optional, default 5 — maximum hits shown).
tool_b.outputs: Plain text: a header reporting hit counts, then one ranked list of file paths; a hit shows an excerpt, its source, and a confidence value (0-1).
tool_b.failure_behaviour: No matches: status OK, only the header prints, counts zero; no list.

tool_c.purpose: Finds registered mechanisms whose declared function matches a described need.
tool_c.inputs: need (string, required — what you want to accomplish).
tool_c.outputs: A ranked list of at most 3 entries, best first: each entry's file path and declared function; scored on phrase and term matches, only scores above 0.5 listed.
tool_c.failure_behaviour: Below threshold: status OK, a no-match message naming the need, then an advisory that one may need building.

tool_d.purpose: Runs ranked full-text search over a local document corpus.
tool_d.inputs: query (string, required); top (integer, optional, default 5 — maximum results).
tool_d.outputs: A header reporting matches found and corpus size, then a ranked list of matching documents, best match first (term-frequency ranking, rare terms weighted higher), each with a short excerpt; no numeric scores are printed.
tool_d.failure_behaviour: No matches: status OK, the header reads 'no matches' with the corpus size; no list.

tool_e.purpose: Finds files by literal text content or by file-name pattern.
tool_e.inputs: operation (string, required — "contents" or "names"); pattern (string, required — regex); scope (path, optional, default repo root).
tool_e.outputs: Matching file paths; contents mode adds the matching lines.
tool_e.failure_behaviour: No matches: status OK with empty output. Unknown operation: status ERROR with a usage message.
